generatedFrom.requirements: requirements/ (158 tickets, MM-1 to MM-158; 33 done, 7 in-progress, 118 proposed)
generatedFrom.statusSource: mm req list (ticket status in requirements/ is authoritative; the built/remaining lists here are a snapshot)

workstreamStatus.not-started: No ticket in the workstream is built.
workstreamStatus.partially-built: Some tickets are done; the remaining ones are not being worked on.
workstreamStatus.in-progress: Remaining tickets are actively being built.

conventions.edgeDirection: An edge runs from the prerequisite workstream (from) to the dependent workstream (to).

edgeTypes.hard-blocker: The dependent steps cannot be built correctly until the satisfiedBy tickets are done.
edgeTypes.contract-dependency: The dependent steps build on a shared type, API, schema or component that the prerequisite defines. Starting early is possible only by agreeing the contract first; otherwise expect rework.
edgeTypes.soft-preferred-order: Either order works. The stated order avoids rework or gives a better result.
edgeTypes.integration-risk: No ordering is implied. Both workstreams change the same code and must coordinate.

conventions.edgeSatisfied: An edge is satisfied when every ticket in satisfiedBy has status done in requirements/. An edge with an empty satisfiedBy is never 'satisfied'; it is a standing coordination note.
conventions.edgeScope: scope is 'all' or a list of step numbers in the dependent workstream's sequence. Steps not listed are not affected by the edge.
conventions.stepAvailable: A step is available when every hard-blocker and contract-dependency edge whose scope includes it is satisfied, and every earlier step in the same workstream that it builds on is done. Steps within a workstream are in recommended order; a later step may start early only if its own tickets say nothing depends on the earlier ones.
conventions.dependsOnAndUnlocks: dependsOn and unlocks on a workstream are derived from hard-blocker and contract-dependency edges only.
